d: Long, straight cobalt-blue hair with red under-streaks and bangs is paired with sharp, narrow cobalt-blue eyes and a mature, late-teenage appearance. The build is curvaceous with a large bust. The outfit consists of a white cropped collared shirt with a black tie, a tan open jacket with a chest pocket, and black stockings, all accented by a palette of tan, white, and black. Signature details include a grey battleship turret worn as a hat and large, grey mechanical naval rigging with cannons attached to the back.
